description:
Have you deposited cryptocurrency or investment funds with FVCDigital.com, or are you experiencing withdrawal problems?

In this video, we examine publicly available information surrounding FVCDigital.com, including its online presence, regulatory status, and other warning signs that investors should carefully consider before depositing additional funds or making further payments.

Publicly available information raises significant concerns. At the time of this review, we did not identify evidence that FVCDigital.com is authorised or regulated by a recognised financial regulator. Investors should independently verify any claims regarding licensing, company registration, or regulatory oversight before sending funds.  

We also found that there is very limited independently verifiable information regarding the platform’s operators, corporate structure, and operating history. A lack of transparency can make it difficult for investors to assess the legitimacy of an investment platform and increases the importance of conducting thorough due diligence before investing.  

If you’ve been asked to pay verification fees, taxes, account activation fees, compliance charges, security deposits, liquidity deposits, or any other payment before your funds can be withdrawn, proceed with caution and independently verify the legitimacy of those requests before sending additional money.

At OSINT Intelligence Asset Recovery, we specialize in reviewing cryptocurrency and investment fraud cases through evidence-based investigations. Our case assessments may include reviewing blockchain transaction records, wallet addresses, transaction hashes (TXIDs), platform communications, trading records, and supporting documentation to help determine possible next steps.

If you’ve been affected by FVCDigital.com or are unable to access your funds, contact us for a confidential professional review of your case.
